installCommand: rm -rf node_modules apps/backend/node_modules apps/frontend/node_modules packages/types/node_modules && npx --yes npm@10 install --include=dev --workspaces --include-workspace-root
buildCommand: npm run build --workspace @ala/types && npm run build --workspace @ala/backend && npm install --workspace @ala/frontend --include=dev && npm run build --workspace @ala/frontend
